evals.name: datamodule-skeleton
evals.prompt: I have a custom industrial defect dataset with a non-standard directory layout. What classes do I need to implement to add it as a new anomalib datamodule?
evals.expected_output: Implement an AnomalibDataset subclass (under datasets/image/) that builds a samples DataFrame, and an AnomalibDataModule subclass (under datamodules/image/) that implements _setup() to create train_data and test_data.
expectations: Dataset subclass builds self.samples as a pandas DataFrame with image_path and split columns
DataModule subclass implements _setup() setting self.train_data and self.test_data

evals.name: use-folder-instead
evals.prompt: My data is organized as root/good/ for normal images and root/defective/ for abnormal images with masks in root/masks/. Do I need to write a new datamodule?
evals.expected_output: No — use the existing Folder datamodule directly with normal_dir='good', abnormal_dir='defective', mask_dir='masks'. Only write a new datamodule if the data needs custom parsing logic Folder can't express.
expectations: Recommends using existing Folder datamodule instead of writing new code
Shows correct Folder constructor args (normal_dir, abnormal_dir, mask_dir)
States a new datamodule is only needed for non-standard parsing logic

evals.name: registration
evals.prompt: How do I export my new datamodule so it works from the CLI with --data?
evals.expected_output: Add import and __all__ entry in src/anomalib/data/__init__.py alongside existing datamodules.image imports. Then usable as anomalib.data.MyDataModule from CLI.

evals.name: test-dummy-generator
evals.prompt: I added a new DataFormat for my dataset. How do I add tests without checking in real data?
evals.expected_output: Add a _generate_dummy_<format>_dataset method to DummyImageDatasetGenerator in tests/helpers/data.py. The session fixture auto-discovers it. Then write a datamodule test consuming the generated path.
expectations: Explains the method name must match _generate_dummy_{data_format.value}_dataset
States the session-scoped fixture auto-discovers it via getattr
Shows how to consume generated data in a test fixture

evals.name: samples-dataframe-requirements
evals.prompt: What columns and attributes does the self.samples DataFrame need for a segmentation dataset?
evals.expected_output: Required columns: image_path and split. For segmentation: also mask_path. Must set samples.attrs['task'] = 'segmentation'. Assign (not mutate) self.samples to trigger validation.
expectations: Lists image_path and split as required columns
Lists mask_path as required for segmentation datasets
Notes self.samples must be assigned (not mutated in place) to trigger the setter validation
